title: HideChat
description: Hide and show your chat instantly with a keybind — a clean, client-side Fabric mod with a quick green/red flash to confirm each toggle. Messages keep arriving in the background, so nothing is lost.
body:
# Chat Toggle

A lightweight, **client-side** Fabric mod that hides and shows your chat with a single keypress — with a clean visual confirmation each time.

## What it does
- Press a key (default **H**, under *Controls → Multiplayer*) to toggle the chat overlay on or off.
- Hiding is purely visual: messages still arrive and stack up in the background — **nothing is dropped**, and your vanilla chat settings are untouched.
- You can still open chat to type or run commands while it's hidden; you just won't see the history.
- Each toggle plays a quick **350 ms bar** at the chat line: **green** when chat is shown, **red** when hidden. It always plays — even with no messages on screen.

## Why
Sometimes chat gets in the way — screenshots, cinematic shots, PvP, or just a cleaner HUD. chat toggle gives you an instant, reversible way to clear it without digging through options or losing messages.

## Details
- Client-side only — works on any server, nothing needed server-side.
- No config files, no extra menus. Install and bind a key.
- Tiny footprint.

## Requirements
- Minecraft **26.2**
- Fabric Loader **0.19.3+**
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)

## Install
1. Install Fabric for 26.2.
2. Put **Fabric API** and **chat toggle** in your `mods` folder.
3. Launch, then bind **Toggle Chat** under *Options → Controls → Multiplayer* (defaults to **H**).
